title: Microbial community assembly in wastewater treatment facility bioreactors
description: Four wastewater treatment facilities were selected for this study, and bioreactor samples were collected weekly from July 2015 through July 2016. Facilities W, X, Y have continuous-flow reactor systems and facility Z haas sequencing batch reactors. Facilities W and Z have parallel bioreactors.
